title: The lane lint passes the lane's PR body to ci-job, so an excuse in the PR body reads as it does in CI
why: `merge --lane-lint` runs bin/ci-job without the lane's PR body, and ci-job maps `${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}` to "". So an excuse that lives only in the PR body (Drops-lines, Retire-run) reads FAIL before CI, even when CI would pass (lane silent-undo-reads-retire-run, session_013NEJL4TDRWqka4aSU2Bv7L, 04:06 CST Nov 8; coordinator 04:07 CST).
note: Fix: the lane lint reads the lane's PR body and passes it as ci-job's PR_BODY value. Red case first: a lane whose Retire-run line is only in its PR body FAILs the lane lint today; control: with no PR the lane lint behaves as today. Owner: lane session_013NEJL4TDRWqka4aSU2Bv7L, a follow-up from #1712's head with Merge after: #1712, after step pre-existing-needs-main-run; the lane reports doing when it starts. Related: steps silent-undo-ci-body and silent-undo-checks-pr-base. Queue fix (coordinator, 04:07 CST Nov 8). Filed 04:08 CST Nov 8. Doing (lane, 04:10 CST Nov 8): red tests started on branch lane-lint-reads-pr-body from 5e95ca9b5; its PR merges after pre-existing-needs-main-run. Ready as draft #1932, with runner 8, `Merge after: #1712` (lane, 05:25 CST Nov 8). Round 3 notes go to step lane-lint-body-tidy. #1871 sighting (06:51 CST Nov 8): the Drops-lines line in the PR body cleared CI's silent-undo check, but lane lint showed a false FAIL because it cannot read the body. Overlap to watch: step silent-undo-cli-ignores-pr-body (lane session_013NEJKzjkypcToggneCjJN8). 07:01 CST Nov 8: overlap settled between the lanes. Draft PR #1969 (nfp-undo-pr-body, lane notes-fix-page) owns the silent-undo PR-body read; lane process-held-end-to-end drops branch silent-undo-reads-body (nothing pushed), and its two edge cases (a non-session last-paragraph URL is not skipped; a ref target passes no body) go into #1969 round 2 as control cases.
